memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'In breeding season I once had a dream in which I looked up and saw that the male goats mating with the flock were streaked, speckled or spotted. The angel of God said to me in the dream, "Jacob." I answered, "Here I am." And he said, "Look up and see that all the male goats mating with the flock are streaked, speckled or spotted, for I have seen all that Laban has been doing to you. I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me. Now leave this land at once and go back to your native land."'" - Gen 31:10-13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Jacob describes a dream in which God spoke to him. And listen to how God identifies Himself: "I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me." God reaches back twenty years to that lonely night when Jacob, a fleeing fugitive, saw the stairway to heaven and met God for the first time. God had not forgotten Bethel. He remembered the pillar, the vow, the whole encounter.

What a beautiful truth about God: He remembers our meetings with Him. That moment years ago when you first trusted Christ, that night you cried out to Him, that promise you made or the promise He made to you — God has not forgotten a single one. He keeps track of His covenant with us far better than we do.

At Bethel, God had promised, "I am with you... I will bring you back to this land" (Gen 28:15). Now He is keeping that word to the letter, telling Jacob it is time to go home. God is faithful to every promise He makes; not one falls to the ground.

Whatever God has spoken to you, He remembers it, and He will fulfil it in His time. He is "the God of Bethel" — the God who keeps covenant across the years. Rest your hope on His unfailing memory and faithfulness.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What past encounter with God do I need to remember afresh?
2. Do I trust that God remembers and keeps every promise He makes?
3. How does God's faithfulness across the years strengthen my hope?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, thank You that You remember every meeting with You and keep every promise You make. You are the God of Bethel, faithful across all my years. Help me to rest in Your faithfulness. Amen.
